name: Goa
notes: New terminal-first Go coding agent. Current upstream documents go install/build installation, OpenAI-compatible providers including llama.cpp, LM Studio, and Ollama, transparent tool I/O, profiles, persistent sessions, worktree isolation, pair/reviewer modes, swarm orchestration, goals, workflows, and a rich ANSI TUI.

name: Tutti
notes: New terminal-first agent-operations CLI. Current upstream documents a Cargo install, tt binary, tmux-managed multi-agent sessions, git worktree isolation, repeatable workflows defined in tutti.toml, persistent team launch, dashboards, review/merge gates, budgets, issue-claim leases, and adapters for Claude Code, Codex, Aider, OpenClaw, and API-direct providers.
